description: A fitness coach creates a client intake form in the designer's workspace: a form from one description, elicitation questions chosen by a committee of 4 drafts with their previews, one suggested answer applied, one typed answer previewed and applied. Recorded with the live model through tests/e2e/designer-workspace.spec.ts.
steps: Describe the form and generate it (intentToSchema)
Apply a suggested answer from its preview (no model call); intent kept in step (syncIntentFromFieldEdit)
Type an answer: its preview (previewDesignProbeOptionsAction), then apply it
Ask an answered question again (no model call)
